_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).

events.label: Defenestration of Prague starts the Bohemian Revolt
events.desc: Bohemian Protestant nobles throw two imperial governors from a window of Prague Castle.

events.label: Bohemian estates elect Frederick V king
events.desc: The estates depose Ferdinand II and offer the crown to the Elector Palatine.

events.label: Battle of White Mountain
events.desc: Imperial and Catholic League forces defeat the Bohemians near Prague.

events.label: Denmark enters the war
events.wiki: Danish intervention in the Thirty Years' War
events.desc: Christian IV of Denmark intervenes on the Protestant side.
events.check: no Wikidata item for the linked article

events.label: Edict of Restitution
events.desc: Ferdinand II orders the return of church lands taken since 1552.

events.label: Gustavus Adolphus lands in Pomerania
events.wiki: Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years' War

events.label: Sack of Magdeburg
events.desc: Imperial troops storm and burn Magdeburg; most of its people die.

events.label: Battle of Breitenfeld
events.desc: Gustavus Adolphus defeats Tilly near Leipzig.

events.label: Battle of Lützen
events.desc: The Swedes hold the field against Wallenstein, but Gustavus Adolphus is killed.

events.label: Wallenstein is assassinated
events.desc: The imperial general is killed at Eger by officers loyal to the emperor.

events.label: Battle of Nördlingen
events.desc: Imperial and Spanish forces defeat the Swedes and their German allies.

events.label: Peace of Prague
events.desc: The emperor makes peace with Saxony and most German Protestant states.

events.label: France declares war on Spain
events.desc: France enters the war openly against the Habsburgs.

events.label: Battle of Rocroi
events.desc: The French under the duc d'Enghien defeat the Spanish army of Flanders.

events.label: Peace of Westphalia
events.desc: Treaties signed at Münster and Osnabrück end the war; Spain recognises Dutch independence.
